question: What scope of reality should be encompassed when meditating in each place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object meditated upon extends from Shiva to Avici.
The scope covers the full range of existence.
inference: One should meditate in each place on that which extends from Shiva down to Avici.
